item_short_desc: Gear up with Rothco’s Reversible Hi-Visibility Uniform Jacket. This reversible jacket offers waterproof protection and hi-vis functionality with reflective striping, featuring badge tabs and large pockets for public safety personnel. Convenient utility features include side zippers that allow quick access to inside pockets, while large lower pockets on the black side offer ample storage space for essential gear and equipment. Maintain your professional appearance with epaulets on the black side to add an extra touch of professionalism.
